118:t_005:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Introducing himself at a time like this...!」

118:t_005:4.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「That stuck-up way of talking... I'd say he's an insufferable jerk.」

118:t_005:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Be careful. With that much confidence... he must have some kind of plan.」

118:t_005:6.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Heh heh heh... Like the small fry you are, your instincts are sharp. But even if you see it, you have no way to counter it.」

118:t_005:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Exactly...! This is my trump card!」

118:t_006:0.en:
$$カツ$$
「Trump card, my foot! It's just an $$アンゲロイ$$!」

118:t_006:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「Don't move rashly...! That one is... different somehow...!」

118:t_006:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Pure intent, only for attacking...! No, it's more like an impulse!」

118:t_006:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Is it some kind of sympathy between lower life forms? You're quite right.」

118:t_006:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「The one piloting that $$アンゲロイ$$ is an $$インセクト$$... a soldier modified from the insects of this planet.」

118:t_006:6.en:
$n
「You turned the aggressiveness and discipline of insects into a weapon...!」

118:t_006:7.en:
$$スズネ$$
「That man... doesn't seem to know the saying that even the tiniest bug has its pride.」

118:t_006:8.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Go, $$インセクト$$s! Your target is their battleship... the blue one first!」

118:t_006:9.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「You mean the $$トレミー$$!?」

118:t_006:10.en:
$$ギルター$$
「If the mothership goes down, the battle is decided. I'll teach you the basics of tactics.」

118:t_006:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「He certainly seems confident in his cunning.」

118:t_006:12.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, you heard that! Shoot down everything that gets near the $$プトレマイオス$$, one after another!」

118:t_006:13.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Don't let your guard down. Those insect soldiers specialize in attack, and they charge in with no regard for their own lives.」

118:t_006:15.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Yeah, I know...! Leave that part to me!」

118:t_007:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Struggle, struggle...! But you're already inside the trap I prepared!」

118:t_007:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Now! Time for the finishing touch!」

118:t_008:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「At this rate we'll be surrounded!」

118:t_009:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Fool! As if a battleship's speed could shake off my $$インセクト$$s!」

118:t_010:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$インセクト$$s, attack all at once!」

118:t_011:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Hey, Commander! You're free to act clever, but if you can't even size up your opponent's strength, you can't beat our tactical forecaster!」

118:t_011:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「S-Silence! There's no way a boost like that can last forever!」

118:t_011:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「The moment it runs out is when you...!」

118:t_011:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We'll end this before then.」

118:t_014:1.en:
$$グラハム$$
「$$プリベンター$$ Lightning will now provide support for $c.」

118:t_014:2.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone! From today on, we fight alongside you!」

118:t_014:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「N-No way...! That woman... did she calculate even this far when she lured the $$インセクト$$s in!?」

118:t_014:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$ギルター・ベローネ$$... you weren't the only one who had prepared a trump card.」

118:t_014:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「While you drive your opponent into the worst situation, you must also plan for your own worst situation... It seems you forgot the basics of tactics.」

118:t_014:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Silence! If it's come to this, strategy is unnecessary! I'll win by overpowering you!」

118:t_014:8.en:
$n
「That's not something a guy who prided himself on cunning should say.」

118:t_014:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If their plans have run out, we'll break through them head-on...!」

118:t_014:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I'm counting on you, Lightning. And you too, Lieutenant $$パトリック$$.」

118:t_014:11.en:
$$グラハム$$
「That is why I came here.」

118:t_014:12.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Watch this, $$サイデリアル$$! There are still tons of people on Earth who haven't given up!」

118:t_014:13.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We're going on the offensive! We decide this in one go!」

118:t_015:0.en:

「$$インセクト$$s, attack all at once!」

118:t_015:2.en:
